pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown patches exhibit complex, irregular geometry with high-frequency serrations and star-like dendritic extensions along the edges. The transition from light to dark pixels is sharp, and patch spatial area is largest on the upper flank, becoming more fragmented and smaller toward the posterior and lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The negative-space network is composed of cream-colored pathways that form a continuous polygonal tiling. Intersections are clearly defined, primarily as tri-radial nodes. The pixel thickness of these corridors is relatively consistent throughout the mid-flank region, creating a stark contrast with the patch edges.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the superior neck line presents as a dark, linear boundary with low-amplitude, high-frequency jaggedness, representing individual hair clusters against the background depth.
